verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit documents context-aware reviews that go beyond the hunk. It auto-applies repository guideline files (.cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) and learned team preferences as review criteria, which covers existing conventions. Linked-repository analysis detects breaking changes and API mismatches across repo boundaries, which covers related modules and callers. Missing for 10: no explicit first-party description of in-repo call-site or dependency-graph analysis during review, and no independent or hands-on evidence that comments actually reference code outside the diff.
